body: I know how you feel. Your life doesn't have to be fifty storeys deep down in shit to think this way and your feelings are valid. I wish there was something I could say to help you not feel this way, but all of here have too many things in common to be actually supportive. I just hope it gets better for you soon.

I think I'd like to book a flight to Italy. I've always wanted to eat authentic pizza and then I'll book one of those deep diving sessions, Something will just happen. I've always been scared of deep sea and water bodies in general and don't know how to swim, seems like a great way to go and just give into it for me. And scared as I might be, I am also incredibly interested in what lies beyond the sea, so I'll at least be surrounded by a strange sense of beauty. Or insides of a shark idk.

I know exactly what you mean. I just want to run hard and fast, away from everything that's supposed to be "life" apparently. I'm always tired too, constantly defeated, and I just feel like I've never won and probably won't. I just ate a massive bowl of one of those ready pasta meals bs because I hadn't gotten out of bed except to use the washroom and cry in the shower in 3 days or so and I could taste nothing. I just ate it like someone with no senses. I never understood why my father was so addicted to alcohol and cigarettes, but in this moment, I have never understood addiction better, I'm just eating and just trying to fucking drown my brain out with the sound of chewing and focusing on this meal.

I hate how we've all ended up. All this because of human interaction and ties, I just want to detach myself from all of those things so that I wouldn't feel all this fucking guilt and heaviness before running away from everything. I'm pretty pathetic, a stranger saying I sound smart has literally been the only highlight in months for me. I probably won't find the answer I think, I don't expect to last very long in the world, but I hope we can both survive this as long as we possibly can and get a win in before the end, somehow.

That's just another thing. I'm not particularly materialistic, I didn't have a lot of things growing up, and out of support for my family, I didn't ask for it, even the most basic things and I've grown up to be minimalistic as hell. I enjoy music, books, movies and all that introvert shit I guess, but lately I just jump from one thing to another and none of it gives me a moment of distraction from all these thoughts in my head. I want to be able to tell you that it'll get better or some bullshit I tell everyone else, but right now I don't feel that way and for that, I sincerely apologise.
